title: UPDATED Ultimate Break a Lucky Block Automation Script
features:
✨ Features:

OP Auto-Farm (Brainrot): Speed-farm LuckyBlocks with advanced priority filters for every rarity, from "Common" to "God".

💸 Auto Collect Tycoon: Effortless passive income – automatically collects all coins at your base while you focus on farming.

💰 Min. Cash Filter: Only collect Brainrots that meet your specific $/s requirements to maximize your efficiency.

🛡️ Auto-Delete Mobs: Background removal of annoying mobs like Sammy, Timmy, or Bosses so your farm loop is never interrupted.

💾 Smart Persistence: Your rarity selections, cash filters, and access keys are saved locally – enjoy automatic login every time you execute.

🥔 Performance Mode: Maximize your FPS with the built-in Potato Mode and the option to disable 3D Rendering entirely.
